description.zh: Sergio Paniego 公开的评分参考资料，按 7 个上游模型标签分组。139 行中 138 个样本可显示，1 个截断且无 PNG 的样本保留失败元数据并纳入均值分母。日期为数据集公开日期，不代表精确运行时刻；模型标签按来源保留，未独立认证。上游输出，非本馆排名。本区不进入主时间线、全部作品或案例总数。
description.en: Scoring reference published by Sergio Paniego, grouped by seven source-reported model labels. Of 139 rows, 138 have viewable images; one truncated row without a PNG retains its failure metadata and remains in the mean denominator. The date is dataset publication, not an exact run date. Model labels are not independently authenticated. Upstream outputs, not a Pelican Map ranking. Excluded from the main timeline, collection and case total.
